Title: Verify header section elements
Pre-Requisite: Browser is open and application URL is loaded
Test_Steps: Observe the header section of the page
Expected_result: Logo displaying "Demo Web Shop Sample Application by Tricentis", search bar with placeholder "Search store" and "Search" button, and top navigation links ("Register", "Log in", "Shopping cart(0)", "Wishlist(0)") should be present.

Title: Verify top category menu bar links
Pre-Requisite: Browser is open and application URL is loaded
Test_Steps: Check the top category menu bar below the header
Expected_result: Links for "BOOKS", "COMPUTERS", "ELECTRONICS", "APPAREL & SHOES", "DIGITAL DOWNLOADS", "JEWELRY", and "GIFT CARDS" should be visible.

Title: Verify left sidebar panels
Pre-Requisite: Browser is open and application URL is loaded
Test_Steps: Inspect the left sidebar panels
Expected_result: "CATEGORIES" block (7 category links), "MANUFACTURERS" block ("Tricentis"), and "NEWSLETTER" block should be displayed properly.

Title: Verify "Your Personal Details" fieldset
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Registration page
Test_Steps: Inspect "Your Personal Details" section
Expected_result: "Gender:" radio options ("Male", "Female"), field labels ("First name:", "Last name:", "Email:") with mandatory red asterisk (*) indicators should be present.

Title: Verify "Your Password" fieldset
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Registration page
Test_Steps: Inspect "Your Password" section and submit button
Expected_result: "Password:" and "Confirm password:" inputs with red asterisks (*), and grey "Register" submission button should be displayed.

Title: Verify footer layout and copyright text
Pre-Requisite: Browser is open and application URL is loaded
Test_Steps: Scroll to the bottom of the page
Expected_result: 4-column footer layout ("INFORMATION", "CUSTOMER SERVICE", "MY ACCOUNT", "FOLLOW US") and bottom copyright/trademark text ("Powered by nopCommerce") should be present.

Title: Verify login page title and fieldset containers
Pre-Requisite: Navigate to the Login page from header link
Test_Steps: Observe the main content area below the top menu
Expected_result: Page title heading "Welcome, Please Sign In!" and split two-column fieldset containers ("New Customer" and "Returning Customer") should be visible.

Title: Verify "New Customer" panel contents
Pre-Requisite: Navigate to the Login page
Test_Steps: Inspect the left "New Customer" fieldset container
Expected_result: Description text ("By creating an account on our website...") and grey "Register" navigation button should be properly aligned.

Title: Verify "Returning Customer" panel components
Pre-Requisite: Navigate to the Login page
Test_Steps: Inspect the right "Returning Customer" fieldset container
Expected_result: "Email:" and "Password:" text inputs, "Remember me?" checkbox, "Forgot password?" hyperlink, and grey "Log in" button should be present.

Title: Verify "About login / registration" info block
Pre-Requisite: Navigate to the Login page
Test_Steps: Check the section below the split login fieldsets
Expected_result: "About login / registration" info block with descriptive text ("Put your login / registration information here...") should be present and correctly aligned.

Title: Verify image banner carousel slider
Pre-Requisite: Browser is open and application homepage is loaded
Test_Steps: Observe the central banner section below the top menu
Expected_result: Image banner carousel slider displaying text ("Speed changes everything. The world's #1 testing and automation platform") with pagination indicator dots should be present.

Title: Verify left sidebar "POPULAR TAGS" block
Pre-Requisite: Browser is open and application homepage is loaded
Test_Steps: Inspect the left sidebar below the manufacturers block
Expected_result: "POPULAR TAGS" tag cloud block containing tags (e.g., "apparel", "awesome", "book", "camera", "cool", etc.) and the "View all" link should be visible.

Title: Verify right sidebar "COMMUNITY POLL" block
Pre-Requisite: Browser is open and application homepage is loaded
Test_Steps: Inspect the right sidebar below the newsletter block
Expected_result: "COMMUNITY POLL" block displaying question ("Do you like nopCommerce?"), radio options ("Excellent", "Good", "Poor", "Very bad"), and "Vote" button should be present.

Title: Verify "FEATURED PRODUCTS" grid rendering
Pre-Requisite: Browser is open and application homepage is loaded
Test_Steps: Scroll down to the "FEATURED PRODUCTS" section
Expected_result: Grid rendering product thumbnail image, product title, star rating bar, red price text (e.g., "$25 Virtual Gift Card", "14.1-inch Laptop", "Build your own cheap computer"), and green "Add to cart" buttons should be displayed correctly.

Title: Verify shopping cart data table layout columns
Pre-Requisite: Items are added to the cart and user is on the Shopping Cart page
Test_Steps: Inspect the items data table layout in the shopping cart
Expected_result: Table displays columns for "Remove" (checkbox), product image thumbnail, "Product(s)" description (with configuration attributes like Processor, RAM, HDD, and "Edit" link), "Price", "Qty." input box, and green "Total" text.

Title: Verify action buttons positioning
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Shopping Cart page with items in the cart
Test_Steps: Check the area directly beneath the shopping cart table
Expected_result: Grey "Update shopping cart" and "Continue shopping" action buttons are positioned correctly and directly beneath the cart table.

Title: Verify bottom control blocks
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Shopping Cart page
Test_Steps: Inspect the bottom control section below the cart table
Expected_result: "Discount Code" fieldset with "Apply coupon" button, "Gift Cards" fieldset with "Add gift card" button, and "Estimate shipping" dropdown selectors (Country, State/province, Zip/postal code) are present.

Title: Verify order summary right-aligned totals block
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Shopping Cart page with items
Test_Steps: Inspect the bottom-right section of the shopping cart page
Expected_result: Order summary block displays right-aligned totals ("Sub-Total:", "Shipping:", "Tax:", "Total:"), terms of service agreement checkbox with "(read)" link, and grey "Checkout" button.

Title: Verify empty wishlist title and state text styling
Pre-Requisite: User is logged in and no items are saved in the wishlist
Test_Steps: Navigate to the Wishlist page with an empty wishlist
Expected_result: Main page title heading "Wishlist" and empty wishlist state text ("The wishlist is empty!") styling should be displayed correctly.

Title: Verify footer copyright ownership text
Pre-Requisite: Browser is open and application page is loaded
Test_Steps: Scroll to the bottom copyright bar of the page
Expected_result: Footer copyright bar should display the correct ownership text ("Copyright © 2026 Tricentis Demo Web Shop. All rights reserved.").

Title: Positive Registration Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Registration page
Test_Data: Valid First name, Last name, unique Email, valid Password (matching criteria)
Test_Steps: Select a gender radio button, fill in all mandatory fields with valid data, and click "Register"
Expected_result: User registers successfully and confirmation message is displayed.

Title: Mandatory Field Blank Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Registration page
Test_Steps: Leave all mandatory fields blank and click "Register"
Expected_result: Appropriate inline error messages are displayed (e.g., "First is required", "Last name is required", "Email is required", "Password is required").

Title: Invalid Email Format Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Registration page
Test_Data: Invalid email format (e.g., missing @ or domain)
Test_Steps: Enter an invalid email format into the Email field and submit or tab out
Expected_result: Email field displays a validation error message.

Title: Password Mismatch Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Registration page
Test_Data: Password and Confirm password do not match
Test_Steps: Enter differing passwords in the "Password" and "Confirm password" fields and submit
Expected_result: Generates an error indicating passwords do not match.

Title: Duplicate Email Registration Check
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Registration page
Test_Steps: Enter an existing registered email address and fill other mandatory fields, then click "Register"
Expected_result: Displays a duplicate account error message (e.g., "The specified email already exists").

Title: Password Strength / Length Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Registration page
Test_Data: Password shorter than minimum required length
Test_Steps: Enter an insecure or short password in the Password field and submit
Expected_result: System validates password length and displays appropriate security/length error message.

Title: Positive Login
Pre-Requisite: User has a registered account and is on the Login page
Test_Steps: Enter valid credentials in the "Returning Customer" panel and click the "Log in" button
Expected_result: User logs in successfully and is redirected to the home/account page.

Title: Blank Credentials Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Login page
Test_Steps: Leave email and password fields blank and click the "Log in" button
Expected_result: Displays an appropriate inline validation error message.

Title: Invalid Email / Unregistered User Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Login page
Test_Steps: Enter an invalid/unregistered email and click "Log in"
Expected_result: Displays an authentication error message (e.g., "Login was unsuccessful. Please correct the errors and try again.").

Title: Incorrect Password Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Login page
Test_Data: Valid registered email with an incorrect password
Test_Steps: Enter a valid email and wrong password, then click "Log in"
Expected_result: Displays an error message indicating invalid credentials.

Title: "Remember me?" Functionality
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Login page
Test_Steps: Select the "Remember me?" checkbox during login
Expected_result: Successfully preserves the user session or pre-populates credentials upon subsequent browser sessions.

Title: "Forgot password?" Navigation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Login page
Test_Steps: Click the "Forgot password?" hyperlink
Expected_result: Redirects the user to the password recovery page to enter their registered email.

Title: New Customer Navigation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Login page
Test_Steps: Click the "Register" button inside the "New Customer" panel
Expected_result: Correctly navigates the user to the account registration page.

Title: Add Item from Catalog
Pre-Requisite: User is on the homepage or category page
Test_Data: Product tile (e.g., Laptop or Virtual Gift Card)
Test_Steps: Click the green "Add to cart" button on any product tile
Expected_result: Successfully adds the item and updates the header badge counter (e.g., Shopping cart(1)).

Title: Configurable Product Addition
Pre-Requisite: User is on a configurable product details page
Test_Steps: Select parameters and click "Add to cart"
Expected_result: Correctly adds the configured item with attributes displayed in the cart.

Title: Update Quantities
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Shopping Cart page with items
Test_Steps: Modify the quantity input box in the shopping cart table and click "Update shopping cart"
Expected_result: Correctly recalculates individual item totals and the final "Sub-Total".

Title: Remove Item from Cart
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Shopping Cart page with items
Test_Steps: Select the "Remove" checkbox for a line item and update the cart
Expected_result: Successfully deletes the product and updates the total amount.

Title: Apply Discount / Coupon Code
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Shopping Cart page
Test_Steps: Enter a valid coupon code in the "Discount Code" field and click "Apply coupon"
Expected_result: Successfully applies the discount to the order summary.

Title: Estimate Shipping Calculation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Shopping Cart page
Test_Data: Valid Country, State, and Zip code
Test_Steps: Select destination details under "Estimate shipping" and click the button
Expected_result: Correctly calculates shipping rates.

Title: Terms of Service Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Shopping Cart page with items and terms checkbox unchecked
Test_Steps: Attempt to click the grey "Checkout" button without checking the "I agree with the terms of service" checkbox
Expected_result: Prevents progression and triggers a notification/alert.

Title: Proceed to Checkout
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Shopping Cart page with items
Test_Steps: Check the terms of service agreement box and click "Checkout"
Expected_result: Successfully transitions the user to the checkout workflow (Billing address step).

Title: Billing Address Selection
Pre-Requisite: User is at the Billing Address step of checkout
Test_Data: Saved or newly filled billing address
Test_Steps: Fill out or select a saved billing address during checkout and click "Continue"
Expected_result: Successfully advances the user to the shipping address/method step.

Title: Shipping Method Selection
Pre-Requisite: User is at the Shipping Method step
Test_Data: Preferred shipping option (e.g., Ground, Next Day Air)
Test_Steps: Select a preferred shipping option and click "Continue"
Expected_result: Successfully updates the order summary and moves to payment method.

Title: Payment Method Selection
Pre-Requisite: User is at the Payment Method step
Test_Data: Payment gateway option (e.g., Cash On Delivery, Credit Card)
Test_Steps: Select a payment gateway option and click "Continue"
Expected_result: Advances the user to payment information.

Title: Order Placement & Confirmation
Pre-Requisite: User is at the final Order Confirmation step
Test_Steps: Review the final order details on the confirmation step and click "Confirm"
Expected_result: Successfully places the order and displays the order success message with an order ID.

Title: Valid Product Search
Pre-Requisite: User is on any page with the search bar visible
Test_Steps: Enter the full product name in the search bar and click "Search"
Expected_result: Successfully redirects the user to the search results page displaying the matching product tile.

Title: Partial Keyword Search
Pre-Requisite: User is on any page with the search bar visible
Test_Steps: Enter a partial keyword in the search bar and click "Search"
Expected_result: Returns all relevant products matching that search string.

Title: Invalid / Non-Existent Search
Pre-Requisite: User is on any page with the search bar visible
Test_Data: Non-existent product name or random string
Test_Steps: Enter a non-existent search string and click "Search"
Expected_result: Displays an appropriate "No products were found that matched your criteria" message.

Title: Blank Search Validation
Pre-Requisite: User is on any page with the search bar visible
Test_Steps: Click the "Search" button with an empty search input box
Expected_result: Verify system behavior (e.g., alert prompt or remains on current page).

Title: Top Menu Navigation
Pre-Requisite: User is on any page with the top navigation bar visible
Test_Steps: Click any category link in the main navigation bar
Expected_result: Successfully redirects the user to that specific category catalog page.

Title: Left Sidebar Category Sub-menus
Pre-Requisite: User is on a category catalog page
Test_Steps: Click sub-category links in the left sidebar
Expected_result: Correctly filters the displayed product catalog.

Title: Product Sorting & View Modes
Pre-Requisite: User is viewing a category catalog page with multiple products
Test_Data: Sorting criteria (Price Low to High / High to Low, Position/Name)
Test_Steps: Select a sorting option from the dropdown menu
Expected_result: Correctly reorders the catalog grid based on the selected criteria.

Title: My Account Overview
Pre-Requisite: User is logged into the application
Test_Steps: Click "My account" in the footer or header
Expected_result: Navigates to the customer info dashboard displaying personal details, email, and navigation options.

Title: Update Customer Information
Pre-Requisite: User is on the "Customer info" account page
Test_Data: Updated First Name and Last Name
Test_Steps: Modify user details and click "Save"
Expected_result: Successfully updates the profile and displays a confirmation message.

Title: Order History & Details
Pre-Requisite: User is logged in and has past orders
Test_Steps: Select "Orders" under account navigation
Expected_result: Displays a list of past orders with correct Order IDs, status, dates, and a "Details" link.

Title: Address Book Management
Pre-Requisite: User is in the "Addresses" section of the account dashboard
Test_Data: New or edited billing/shipping address details
Test_Steps: Add, edit, or delete a shipping/billing address
Expected_result: Updates successfully.

Title: Add Item to Wishlist
Pre-Requisite: User is on a product details page
Test_Steps: Click "Add to wishlist" on the product details page
Expected_result: Successfully adds the item and updates the header badge (e.g., Wishlist(1)).

Title: Move Wishlist Items to Cart
Pre-Requisite: User is on the Wishlist page with saved items
Test_Steps: Select items inside the Wishlist page and click "Add to cart"
Expected_result: Successfully transfers the products into the active shopping cart.

Title: Newsletter Subscription
Pre-Requisite: User is on any page with the footer/sidebar newsletter section
Test_Steps: Enter a valid email address into the newsletter input box and click "Subscribe"
Expected_result: Displays a confirmation message (e.g., "Thank you for signing up!").

Title: Community Poll Voting
Pre-Requisite: User is on the homepage or sidebar with the Community Poll block
Test_Steps: Select a radio option in the "Community Poll" block and click "Vote"
Expected_result: Records the vote and displays the percentage breakdown results.
